menu_options.cloud: Sign in with a Navien Smart account

cloud.title: Navien Smart
cloud.description: Sign in with your Navien Smart app account.

bluetooth_mat_pair.title: Register the mat
bluetooth_mat_pair.description: Fully close the Navien Smart phone app, put the mat in pairing mode, then submit. This is only needed the first time.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Navien server.
error.mat_refused: The mat refused registration. Restart pairing mode and try again.
error.mat_no_status: The mat sent no status. Try again.
error.mat_connect_failed: Could not connect to the mat. Make sure the app is closed and try again.

abort.already_configured: This account or mat is already configured.
abort.no_devices: No Bluetooth mat was found. Close the app and make sure the mat is on.
abort.bluetooth_unavailable: Home Assistant's Bluetooth integration is unavailable.
abort.single_mat: Single mats cannot be added yet; only left-right split mats are supported.
abort.bluetooth_reauth_unsupported: A Bluetooth mat has no account to log in to. If it cannot connect, remove the mat and register it again.

init.title: Heating pump estimate
init.description: The boiler reports no pump state, so the heating pump is estimated from the action of the thermostats selected here.

data_description.heating_entities: The pump counts as running when any of these thermostats is heating. Leave empty and the estimated sensors are unknown.

mat_model.title: Sleep mat product name
mat_model.description: The mat does not report its product name. Choose it here to display it in the device information.

mat_menu.title: Mat settings
mat_menu.description: Choose a product name or edit a custom sleep program.

custom_program.title: Choose a custom sleep program
custom_program.description: Choose one of the three programs stored in Home Assistant. Reset removes only the chosen program.

custom_left_add.title: Custom sleep left: section {section}
custom_left_add.description: Each side can have up to 5 sections over 12 hours. Remaining: {remaining} hours.

custom_right_add.title: Custom sleep right: section {section}
custom_right_add.description: Each side can have up to 5 sections over 12 hours. Remaining: {remaining} hours.

abort.custom_sleep_running: Stop the active custom sleep program before editing it.
